fileIdentity.what: Inspectable 10-stage source repair and failure-learning candidate record
fileIdentity.why: Source/CI completion and failures were not correlated with the owning C3 mission and independent learning admission boundaries
fileIdentity.how: Read-only GitHub commit, issue, PR, workflow and diagnostic-log reconstruction; fail-closed candidate recording

scope.objective: Expose original Continuum UI through GitHub Pages and pin missing original-host source migration gate

evidence.claim: Root Pages entry links to preserved original UI
Scoped source completion inventory, read-only PowerShell inspector, original source UI blob parity test
Windows run 55/56 tests passed; original HTML worktree Git blob mismatch failed
Malformed test source failed import/syntax on Windows/Linux/macOS
Corrected test passed npm tests and syntax on Linux/macOS/Windows
Merged main commit source-only tests passed on Linux/macOS/Windows
GitHub Pages build/deploy workflow succeeded; not browser visual or live data evidence
Owner-local service and native device/Veritas qualification explicitly blocked
Test asserts Pages route, original UI assets and unchanged committed Git blobs
Canonical C3 mission, outstanding gates and review chronology

phases.name: Investigate
phases.finding: Inspected existing Continuum source, GitHub Pages root and original ui/original/index.html; main was missing root index.

phases.name: Diagnose
phases.finding: Root Pages entry absent; original UI deployed under subpath; dynamic /api/continuum not supplied by GitHub Pages. Last item remains runtime blocker.

phases.name: Plan
phases.finding: Smallest static root redirect to byte-preserved UI; independent branch for source completion, no second writer, no private data migration; revert scoped commits for rollback.

phases.name: Implement
phases.finding: Root index committed to main; source completion and read-only SHA-256 candidate inspector merged; original UI source Git blobs pinned.

phases.name: Test
phases.finding: Original regression attempts failed twice; final source-only tests passed. A previous failure is not erased by later PASS.

phases.name: Validate
phases.finding: Inspected four-file PR scope, passing source checks and Pages workflow; NO independent browser render, owner API or native device validation.

phases.name: Repair
phases.finding: Replaced false Windows worktree-byte hash expectation with committed Git blob comparison. A malformed intervening edit broke test syntax; full test rewrite corrected it.

phases.name: Retest
phases.finding: Final regression and merged main test suites passed on Windows, macOS and Linux; remains source qualification only.

phases.name: Verify
phases.finding: Source CI and deployment workflow observed successful. The original owner runtime, Veritas PRE/POST, receipt chain, live widget and C3 acceptance not verified.

phases.name: Evidence
phases.finding: GitHub commits, PR, successful/failed CI runs, deployment workflow and issue references retained; this record is a review candidate, not a Receipt Ledger artifact.

incidents.signature: Windows checkout worktree hash differs from provenance Git blob
incidents.trigger: Original UI byte test recomputed Git blob hash from checkout bytes
incidents.rootCause: Platform checkout line-ending normalization changes worktree bytes; committed Git blobs retain pinned identity
incidents.correction: Compare git rev-parse HEAD:<path> rather than hashing checked-out source bytes

incidents.signature: Node SyntaxError missing ) after argument list in continuum-pages-entry test
incidents.trigger: Incomplete automated text replacement in test repair
incidents.rootCause: Malformed inserted JavaScript broke test source and caused import failure on three operating systems
incidents.correction: Replace full test module and rerun CI instead of trusting patch mutation alone

incidents.signature: Mission issue lacked loop chronology and normalized lessons after merged source work
incidents.trigger: Missing event-driven handoff before completion reporting
incidents.rootCause: Engineering work recorded in tool/PR history but not reconciled to existing mission issue
incidents.correction: Use existing mission issue for begin, failure, retest, end and permanent bounded source evidence report

nextAction: Inspect the actual running original owner service and source/module SHA-256 on the authorized PC, then reconcile module and provider identity before governed live readback.
